Subject: Crossbeam: Activation readiness & steward runbook

Hi Sophie — great to have the signed SOW back. Attaching the final SOW (Crossbeam_SOW_v2.pdf) and a short summary so we can move straight into kickoff planning. Please reply with the preferred kickoff window and the procurement contact for final invoicing.

Deal summary (short):
- Scope: 3-month pilot (Nov 30 go-live target) for internal search + summarization workflows.
- Capacity: steady-state ~35 qps; burst up to 75 qps.
- Model & infra: r-inference/gpt-large (quantized), hosted with VPC peering for data ingress.
- Security: SOC 2 in-scope, customer-managed KMS for keying (required).
- Billing: monthly usage + $45k pilot commit (SOW attached).

Known risks / open items for CS:
- VPC peering timeline (Crossbeam network team to confirm egress windows).
- KMS integration and HSM approvals (needs procurement & security sign-off).
- Acceptance criteria: production latency <= 350ms p95 and example prompt set results (see MVP checklist).

Internal ask: can CS own the activation and technical onboarding? Vanessa, Jordan — assigning technical steward and backup respectively. Karthik — would you take primary CS ownership for ramp & customer-facing success metrics?

Next steps I propose (quick):
1) Crossbeam confirms kickoff week availability (Nov 8–12 or Nov 15–19).
2) Procurement contact and PO cadence.
3) CS & Infra pre-kickoff sync to validate VPC/KMS windows.

Attachments: [Attachment: Crossbeam_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Internal only — moving the thread to our CS channel. Per Sophie's note, Evan Lowe is procurement/infra contact. Key items below; please review and ack.

Quick context: signed pilot SOW (DEAL-2026-5274). Pilot targets Nov 30 go-live. Customer requires customer-managed KMS and VPC peering. They expect prod latency p95 <= 350ms.

Assignments (proposed):
- CS Lead (customer success & success metrics): Karthik Iyer (primary)
- Technical Implementation Lead (VPC/KMS/infra): Vanessa Ortiz (primary), Jordan Blake (backup)
- Billing / Procurement liaison: Marcus Lin (sales) -> will coordinate PO & invoice cadence with procurement@crossbeam.ai

Immediate blockers & mitigations:
- KMS: Crossbeam requires BYOK (bring your own key). Action: Vanessa to validate Redwood’s KMS flow and schedule demo with Evan 
- VPC peering windows: Crossbeam prefers two maintenance windows; Jordan to confirm our peering/options (static egress vs TGW).
- Acceptance tests: attached MVP-Acceptance-Checklist.xlsx — please add any additional test vectors you want run before sign-off.

Proposed timeline (short):
- Nov 4–6: internal pre-kickoff (config + security review)
- Nov 9 or Nov 16: pre-kickoff w/ Crossbeam infra (confirm exact)
- Nov 17–24: staging validation & acceptance runs
- Nov 30: pilot production flip

Please reply here with any objections. If you accept, Karthik — can you draft the kickoff agenda + invite for Nov 9 morning (subject to Sophie's final confirmation)?
